name: hud_layout_hw_load_type_ii_from_zar_root
description: HudLayoutHW::LoadTypeIIFromZarRoot finds the TYPEII node, loads layout and widget payloads, and records default plus 320/400-line widget image variants.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/source-cluster tier S pass.
The smoke uses deliberately missing image paths, so it verifies the TYPEII traversal, rectangle copies, widget loader calls, and image pointer storage without requiring retail HUD art files.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x412f70 validates zReader_GetNamedNode(parent, "TYPEII"), loading payload[1] into layoutRect and activeRect, applying image widgets from payload[2], payload[3], and payload[4], and storing widget1/widget2 default plus 320/400 variant image pointers from payload[5].

The native smoke builds a minimal TYPEII node tree, verifies layoutRect and activeRect, verifies missing image loads clear the three widget images and stored default/variant pointers, and verifies a missing TYPEII node preserves existing rectangles while returning 1.
